text: AI Modeler lets users build financial models in plain language without writing formulas
quote: Meet AI Modeler: financial models in plain language. No formulas needed.

text: AI runs inside the financial model, so its answers are consistent, reusable and grounded in the business's own model
quote: Abacum runs AI inside your model, so every answer is consistent, reusable, and grounded in how your business actually works.

text: Connects ERP, CRM, HRIS, spreadsheet and data warehouse sources into one governed source of truth
quote: It connects ERP, CRM, HRIS, spreadsheet, and warehouse data into one governed source of truth

text: Multi-entity roll-ups across connected ERPs with normalized charts of accounts
quote: Multi-entity roll-ups with connected ERPs and normalized charts of accounts.

text: Actuals, assumptions, forecasts and scenarios live in one workspace, so the plan can be updated without rebuilding it
quote: Connect actuals, assumptions, forecasts, and scenarios in one governed workspace—so finance can update the plan without rebuilding it.

text: Pipeline, actuals and capacity data are connected in one live model, so board numbers reflect current data
quote: Abacum connects pipeline, actuals and capacity in one live model. So the number you take to the board is today's, not last close's.

text: As actuals flow in, the narrative updates and the presentation deck builds automatically, with no copy-paste
quote: Actuals flow in, the narrative updates, the deck builds itself. No copy-paste between the model, the slides and the memo.

text: Builds the P&L, balance sheet and cash flow from live ERP actuals, so the numbers are current and traceable
quote: Abacum builds P&L, balance sheet and cash flow off live actuals from your ERP, so the numbers are current when someone asks and traceable when they question them.

text: Real-time consolidation of the three financial statements with drill-down to source data
quote: Real-time consolidation of the three statements with drill-down to source data.

text: Analyze revenue, expenses, financial statements and consolidations using data from connected ERP and accounting systems
quote: ERP and Accounting Systems: Easily analyze your revenue, expenses, financial statements, or consolidations.

text: Connect an HRIS to understand and plan for each new hire
quote: Understand and plan for each new hire by connecting your HRIS with Abacum

text: Group-based role assignment for managing user permissions across the workspace from a no-code interface

text: Detailed history of every edit to data models, spaces and dimension mappings
quote: you can maintain a detailed history, offering full visibility into every edit event on your data models, spaces, or dimension mappings.

text: Push and pull data between Excel and Abacum, so Excel stays in use alongside the platform

text: Budgeting and forecasting in one model, combining top-down targets, bottom-up inputs and live actuals
quote: Budgeting and forecasting in one model: top-down targets, bottom-up inputs, live actuals.

text: Build base, bull and bear scenarios from the same base version, with assumption changes flowing through revenue, hiring and cash

text: Plan, approve and forecast headcount in the same connected model as the budget
